Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 44 Carrington Road

Clause 9.44.1 - heritage (heritage): Evidence of this history is still visible today with the Sewerage Pumping Station No. 271 located at the northern section of the precinct. That site is a Heritage Item of State and local significance.

Clause 9.44.1 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): Due to the history of the land in this area the vast majority of the precinct is identified as flood affected.

Clause 9.44.1 - heritage (heritage): However, the precinct contains a number of Heritage Items, some of State significance.

Clause 9.44.2 - other (development_control): To protect the identified Heritage Items within the precinct.

Clause 9.44.2 - other (development_control): To protect, preserve and enhance the identified period buildings within the precinct.

Clause 9.44.2 - other (development_control): To ensure that potential flooding issues are addressed as part of any new development.

Clause 9.44.3 - heritage (heritage): There are no Heritage Conservation Areas contained within the precinct.
